event.text: Besides trouble falling asleep, have you noticed waking during the night, waking too early in the morning, or any changes in mood, energy, or interest in activities?
event.why: Sleep maintenance problems, early awakening, and mood changes would help distinguish primary insomnia from insomnia related to depression or other conditions, which affects both management and safety evaluation.

event.text: I recommend self-care for now: keep a consistent bed and wake time, limit caffeine in the afternoon and evening, avoid alcohol before bed, and get up briefly if you can't fall asleep. You describe a stressful month and say you're still functioning though tired. If you ever feel sleepy while driving, don't drive — pull over somewhere safe if already driving — and arrange clinician review. If sleep stays poor beyond a few more weeks, or you notice low mood or loss of interest, arrange a review in this thread or with your usual provider.
